integrity: The formulas are proved in RESULT.md; a standalone stdlib checker independently enumerates small finite cases. No computational evidence is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The equation considered is f composed with itself equal to the empty partial map, not general nilpotency.
The central limit theorem and parity constants are proved asymptotically along cycle sizes n tending to infinity.
The source monoid restriction theorem is credited to Fernandes and Paulista; global historical priority is not certified.
A related 2022 masters dissertation was not available in full and remains a residual overlap risk.
